TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRICK.description: When played, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold]. This card's cost increases by [blue]1[/blue]{Amount:energyIcons()} this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TRICK.title: Trickery
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HIGH_QUALITY.description: Reduce this card's cost by [blue]1[/blue]{Amount:energyIcons()} for each card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with the same name.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-HIGH_QUALITY.title: Premium
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SNAKE_BITE_UPGRADE.descri: If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at the end of turn, reduce its cost by [blue]1[/blue] until it leaves your [gold]Hand[/gold]. When played, return to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and randomize its cost this turn.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-SNAKE_BITE_UPGRADE.title: SNAKE!!
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE.description:
Gain [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
When played, gain {Amount:energyIcons()}, then add a random coloured card [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Miracle[/purple] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MIRACLE.title: Miracle
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOODSHED.description: Heal {Heal:diff()} HP. The first time each combat this card deals unblocked damage, additionally heal equal to the unblocked damage dealt.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-BLOODSHED.title: Bloodshed
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RECOLLECTION.description: Play this card the first time it enters your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-RECOLLECTION.title: Recollection
TOUHOUANCIENTS-EXORCISM.description: When played, add a [gold]Dream Seal[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-EXORCISM.title: Exorcism
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TSUKUMOGAMI.description:
Gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
At the start of your turn, if there are no cards with [purple]Tsukumogami[/purple] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], move a random card with [purple]Tsukumogami[/purple] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TOUHOUANCIENTS-TSUKUMOGAMI.title: Tsukumogami
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON.descripti: Gains [gold]Eternal[/gold]. Applies an additional [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold]. If this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at end of the turn, it applies an additional [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] this combat.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-MEDICINE_POISON.title: Melancholy Medicine
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OATH.description: When this card is played, play all other [purple]Covenant[/purple] cards. When this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all other [purple]Covenant[/purple] cards.
TOUHOUANCIENTS-OATH.title: Covenant
TOUHOUANCIENTS-WANDERING.description: Up to [blue]{BaseRemainingChance}[/blue] times each turn, if the last card played was an [gold]Attack[/gold], return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain [blue]{BlockAmount}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].

TOUHOUANCIENTS-YUMEIRO.title: Dream Colored

TOUHOUANCIENTS-GREED.description: Gain [gold]Eternal[/gold] and [gold]Replay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue]. If there is any card with [purple]Greed[/purple] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], they must be played before other cards.
